title: Claymation FPS with Gemini Neon!
author: AntiqueFeedback7447
selftext:
Built a claymation style FPS with Gemini Neon, medium effort agents! Its honestly a good model to work with!

You can try to beat it at [https://claycalypse.vercel.app/](https://claycalypse.vercel.app/) 

\- Procedural claymation SDF bodies that allow for chunking and shooting off clay mass, including limbs, face etc.  
\- Stepped claymation animation for the enemies to get a bit more of a "stop motion" feel  
\- Partly destructible environment and props  
\- Multiple enemy types with procedural IK movement, including a final boss in "Hell Mode" :D   
\- Claymation weapon and hand + rig and animations for punch, shoot and reload. 

Took about one foundation and 7 polishing sessions on the first day. Followed up with a few more gameplay polishes on the second day. The model does need its fair share of guidance, but if prompted well it implements fairly quickly and with good output quality! 3D capabilities are also great!  
  
Issue experienced with Neon that were a bit annoying:

* Gets stuck often in thinking/editing loops? Evaluating its own performance metrics?
* Ignores answering questions/input while working sometimes
* Random “abort” errors
* Context window seems to fill up quite quickly (tested mostly with the 300K window)
* Seems to randomly slow down, waiting ages for small edits

Other than that, it picks up design and gameplay concepts quickly once established and follows them well!
